Confirmation of Supervision
Application without a master's degree from a Swiss university or federal institute of technology
Steps in your application for a Doctorate
1: Look yourself for a supervisor; contact the administration of the institute/department of the desired
discipline of your doctorate. There is no list of supervisors at the University of Bern. Ask the
department's/institute's administration if you need assistance.
2: Apply online at www.application.unibe.ch
3: Complete the confirmation of supervision
4: Confirmation of supervision incl. the following documents has to be passed on for signature to the
supervisor:
a) Photocopy of your university degree (Master's degree or Licentiate)
or originally certified photocopy of your university degree and the translation, if your degree is issued in
a language other than German, French, English or Italian
This does not apply to you if you achieved your degree at the same faculty where you want to pursue a doctorate.
b) Photocopy of your academic records (transcripts) or originally certified photocopies and the translation,
if the list of academic records is issued in a language other than German, French, English or Italian
c) Originally certified photocopy of translation if your degree is issued in a language other than German,
French, English or Italian.
Originally certified photocopy of translation if the list of academic records is issued in a language other
than German, French, English or Italian.
d) Curriculum vitae in table form with uninterrupted chronology of your education and academic studies
up to the present
e) Photocopy of your valid identity card (front and back) or valid passport
This does not apply to you if you are a former student of the University of Bern
f) Declaration of consent
5: Application file has to be passed for verification of your entrance qualification to the Admissions Office,
Hochschulstrasse 4, 3012 Bern. If necessary, additional documents will be requested.
6: If you meet our admission requirements, the application file is passed on for signature to the dean's office
of the relevant faculty or study coordination of the relevant graduate school
7: Fully completed confirmation of supervision and application file have to be passed on to the Admissions
Office
8: Delivery of the invoice for the registration and semester fees for doctoral students
confirmation-of-supervision2.docx - 24.04.2025
9: Issuance and delivery of information about your Campus Account, if you are new at the University of Bern
10: Submit the original of your degree for scrutiny to the Admissions Office
11: Certificate of registration and delivery of UNICARD following receipt of payment
